text: ふまんを　はらすために　あいてを　ぜんりょくで　こうげきする。

structure.jp: ふまんを　はらすために
structure.en: in order to vent its frustration

patterns.name: 〜ために
patterns.explanation: ために after a verb says what the action is for. はらすために = 'in order to vent'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells how the action is done. ぜんりょくで = 'with all its might'.
